entries.prompt: Create ONE original ultrawide 21:9 wallpaper requested 2560x1080. Clearly DRAWN expressionist fantasy ink poster, emphatically not realistic or 3D. Subject Fenrir: a lean monstrous wolf sprinting diagonally across the wide frame in a low predatory leap, full body readable, long angular limbs and ragged tail. Asymmetrical rough dry-brush woodcut treatment: large savage IVORY shapes cut from pure BLACK, aggressive thick black contours, sparse slate-gray hatch marks, tiny ember-red eyes as the only vivid color. Fur is stylized jagged brush shapes, never detailed realistic fur. Broken black/white brush trails behind the running wolf provide motion, not scenery. Strong tension and raw energy, generous black breathing room around silhouette. No golden color, no ochre, no rings, no circles, no halo, no crown, no medallion, no knotwork frame, no chains, no armor, no decorative border. No landscape, trees, mountains, moon, lettering or watermark. Original bold graphic illustration, not an engraving or realistic painting.
entries.exportProcessing: Main-subject 16:9 crop and Lanczos upscale; nativeSize records the original generation.
